titre: Devoir de synthèse n°3 - Anglais (1ère année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Doing sport regularly is essential for a healthy life. Firstly, physical activity keeps our body strong and helps us avoid many diseases such as obesity and heart problems. Secondly, sport is good for the mind: after exercising, we feel happier and less stressed. Moreover, team sports like football or basketball teach us important values such as cooperation, discipline and respect for others. Unfortunately, many young people today spend hours sitting in front of screens and do not move enough. Doctors recommend at least sixty minutes of physical activity every day. So let us switch off our screens, go outside and enjoy the many benefits of sport.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) Why is doing sport good for the body?   (1,5 marks)
2) How is sport good for the mind?   (1,5 marks)
3) What values do team sports teach us?   (1,5 marks)
4) How much physical activity do doctors recommend every day?   (1,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "let us / lets": ______ switch off our screens and go outside.   (1,5 marks)
2) Give the comparative: After sport we feel ______ (happy).   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a linker (firstly / because): ______, physical activity keeps our body strong.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "healthy" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"Is doing sport important for young people?" Write a composition (about 12 lines) giving your opinion, with at least two arguments and examples. Use linkers.
